_comment: Migration step for the plugin protocol jump P6 -> P7. Ported from the retired scripts/update_plugin_source.py. Consumed by `mads plugin --update`. See src/main/plugin_migrate.hpp for the transform semantics.

replacements.description: Modernize the nlohmann/json fetch to the release tarball form

source.name: set_params
source.description: set_params now takes a `const json&` instead of an opaque `void const*`
Drop the cast/deref now that params is already a json reference
Pass params by reference at set_params call sites

source.name: load_data
source.params: (json const &input, string topic = "", vector<unsigned char> const *blob = nullptr)

notes: load_data() now receives the source `topic`; use it if your plugin distinguishes inputs by topic.
process()/get_output() now receive an optional `blob` out-parameter; populate it if your plugin emits a binary payload.
If you added your own constructor, make sure it still forwards to the parent (or prefer set_params for configuration).
